editionLabel: Rio Grande Games / Kosmos English rules (2000)
firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently visited a Greek restaurant starts. If neither player has ever visited one, the player taking Hera's role starts.
clarifications: This is a two-player game: one player takes Hera and the other takes Zeus. They alternate turns from the starting player.
internalEvidence: The English Rio Grande Games / Kosmos booklet preserved at Jokerbird was retrieved for inventory BGG identity 638. Printed/PDF page 4 and the publisher credits on page 12 were rendered and visually checked. The first paragraph of Playing the Game states the Greek-restaurant criterion, the Hera fallback if neither player has visited one, and alternating turns. Page 12 credits Kosmos ©2000 and Rio Grande Games. Mirror PDF SHA-256: 4db751de5a26afd08e6097103c084244d2839bc097ae7944febbffdd5c6d01b7. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The booklet gives no tie-break if both players visited a Greek restaurant most recently together.
